question: What are the common patterns can be observed from countries with high income inequality in 2015, knowing gini greater than 0.4 is considered as high inequality
query: SELECT country, iso, gini_reported, gini_recalculated, gdp_ppp_pc_usd2011, population, category, income_net FROM country_income WHERE year = 2015 AND (gini_reported > 0.4 OR gini_recalculated > 0.4) ORDER BY gini_reported DESC LIMIT 50;
